comment: Hand-written talent facts the generic DB2 decode cannot or should not derive. Every entry names its source; 'Classic value' means the number is taken from Classic-era theorycraft and has NOT been measured on Forever yet. 'spells' lists the rank spell ids as the talent export reports them; 'perRank' is multiplied by the exported rank.

entries.name: Suppression
entries.source: Classic value (2% per rank on Affliction spells); Forever unmeasured, CLAUDE.md 2026-11

entries.name: Improved Life Tap
entries.source: Classic value (+10% mana per rank); Forever unmeasured, tooltip not exported

entries.name: Pandemic
entries.source: SoD rune with the same spell id lets Shadow DoTs crit; Forever unverified
